info.title: RelayHub HTTP API
info.description: Shipped MVP routes. JSON bodies are limited to 1 MiB; unknown top-level request fields fail. IDs are opaque. HTTPS production origin. No tenant API is shipped; Go and TypeScript SDKs are available in the repository. Operations endpoints also run on the worker private listener. Standard errors use {error:{code,message}}; unknown routes use 404 not_found and unsupported methods 405 method_not_allowed. CORS is disabled by default; RELAYHUB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS enables exact-origin HTTP CORS and WebSocket origins. Allowed preflights return 204; unsupported methods/headers return 403 forbidden. Actual requests still authenticate. HTTP signature and CORS details: /docs/developer/auth.md.

post.summary: Exchange the bootstrap Admin bearer credential for a browser session
post.description: Returns a CSRF token in the JSON response and sets a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie. The bootstrap bearer and CSRF token are never persisted by RelayHub browser code.

delete.summary: Revoke the current browser Admin session
delete.description: Cookie-authenticated requests require the X-RelayHub-CSRF header. Trusted bearer automation remains accepted during the compatibility period.

patch.description: Nonempty partial update. callback_url:null removes the URL. Unknown fields fail. Name is trimmed. HTTPS is required by default; explicitly enabled local HTTP callbacks follow the documented host restrictions. Concurrent disjoint patches preserve each other's fields through atomic compare-and-swap and merged revalidation. Exhausting 16 conflicts returns 409 conflict; fetch current state and retry. Disable and credential rotation are preserved.

post.summary: Persist an event and one job per target
post.description: Atomic persistence precedes notifications. Target IDs are trimmed, unique, sorted, enabled apps. Type is trimmed and data is an object. Replays return original event and initial job snapshots, including when payload changes; inspect job GET for current state. All targets get durable delivery work regardless of delivery mode.

post.summary: Invoke an application-owned handler over WebSocket
post.description: Any authenticated app knowing an enabled function ID may invoke it. Input is an object; the entire rpc.invoke frame must fit 64 KiB. Only one owner session can claim the invocation (250 ms window). No offline queue or automatic redispatch. Handler ok:false remains HTTP 200. Results and unavailable/timeout outcomes persist for caller/key replay for 24 hours. Same key ignores a changed function/input. Idempotency-Key is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key per logical action, scoped to authenticated producer/caller. Events use configured retention (24h default); functions always 24h. Reusing a key returns the original result even when the submitted content changes. Never put credentials in keys. Maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes.

get.summary: Upgrade to the RelayHub v1 durable stream
get.description: Authenticate a short-lived stream:connect token before upgrade, require the relayhub.stream.v1 WebSocket subprotocol, then exchange frames defined by /docs/asyncapi.yaml. Application identity comes only from the token; NATS subjects and consumer state remain private.

parameters.description: Browser origin must exactly match RELAYHUB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

Token expiry is checked at handshake only. Socket.IO is unsupported. Then exchange /docs/schemas/client-frame.schema.json and server-frame.schema.json frames. Heartbeat, message bounds and reconnect recovery are in /docs/developer/websocket.md.

get.description: Prometheus exposition. API exports HTTP request counts/duration by bounded method, registered route template and status, plus event published/replayed/rejected/store_error outcomes. Replays do not count as new publications. No IDs, URL/query values, credentials, types or payloads are labels. Worker exports callback outcomes on its private listener.

Credentials.description: One-time credentials. Keep only in an approved secret store; never log or expose to browsers. Rotation invalidates both prior values.

name.description: Leading/trailing Unicode whitespace is trimmed with Go strings.TrimSpace. The trimmed value must be nonempty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. This pattern enforces nonempty and a 128-character upper bound after trimming; the runtime additionally enforces the stricter UTF-8 byte limit (for example, 65 é characters exceed it).

callback_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL with a nonempty hostname, no userinfo and no fragment. HTTPS is allowed by default, including private destinations. HTTP requires RELAYHUB_ALLOW_INSECURE_CALLBACKS=true and a host recognized by the runtime as localhost, a .localhost/.local/.internal suffix (case-insensitive, one final dot removed), or an IP satisfying Go IsLoopback or IsPrivate. Link-local IP addresses are excluded. No DNS lookup is performed for this classification.

CreateApp.description: App validation runs after trimming the name. callback/all require a non-null callback_url. queue/websocket allow null. A non-null URL must also satisfy the runtime HTTPS/local-HTTP policy.

name.description: Leading/trailing Unicode whitespace is trimmed with Go strings.TrimSpace. The trimmed value must be nonempty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. callback_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL with a nonempty hostname, no userinfo and no fragment. HTTPS is allowed by default, including private destinations. HTTP requires RELAYHUB_ALLOW_INSECURE_CALLBACKS=true and a host recognized by the runtime as localhost, a .localhost/.local/.internal suffix (case-insensitive, one final dot removed), or an IP satisfying Go IsLoopback or IsPrivate. Link-local IP addresses are excluded. No DNS lookup is performed for this classification.

UpdateApp.description: App validation runs after trimming the name. callback/all require a non-null callback_url. queue/websocket allow null. PATCH is applied to persisted state first: changing to callback/all without a URL is valid only if the existing app already has a valid URL; clearing callback_url is valid only when the resulting mode is queue/websocket. Send delivery_mode and callback_url together when changing both.

PublishEvent.description: Event data must be a valid UTF-8 JSON object. Invalid bytes are rejected before idempotency lookup, persistence or notification. target_app_ids may be omitted or empty when routing rules resolve targets. Raw numbers and valid Unicode are preserved. The complete HTTP body is limited to 1 MiB.

error.description: Exactly lowercase code and message keys, each once, with non-null strings. Runtime rejects duplicate keys and forwards canonical validated JSON. Message limit is 1024 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength is a character bound. The runtime enforces the byte bound.

AdminBearer.description: RELAYHUB_ADMIN_TOKEN; operator only. Browser code exchanges it once and never persists it.

AdminSessionCookie.name: __Host-relayhub_admin
AdminSessionCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly browser Admin session. Non-safe methods also require X-RelayHub-CSRF.

AppApiKey.name: X-RelayHub-Api-Key
AppApiKey.description: Application API key; must accompany timestamp and signature.

AppSignature.name: X-RelayHub-Signature
AppSignature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + LF + method + LF + exact request target (path and query) + LF + lowercase SHA256 of exact body bytes. No trailing LF. Use the UTF-8 bytes of the entire issued HMAC secret; do not decode its prefix or suffix. See /docs/developer/auth.md.

SocketToken.name: token
SocketToken.description: Short-lived server-issued token with ws:connect or stream:connect scope. URL-encode it; omit query strings from logs.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key per logical action, scoped to authenticated producer/caller. Events use configured retention (24h default); functions always 24h. Reusing a key returns the original result even when the submitted content changes. Never put credentials in keys.

Timestamp.name: X-RelayHub-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Unix seconds, decimal text. Default permitted skew is ±300 seconds. Sign this exact text.

Signature.name: X-RelayHub-Signature
Signature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + LF + method + LF + exact request target (path and query) + LF + lowercase SHA256 of exact body bytes. No trailing LF. Use the UTF-8 bytes of the entire issued HMAC secret; do not decode its prefix or suffix. See /docs/developer/auth.md.
